content.p-one-sentence-describing-the-future-amb: Establish a standardized global accounting foundation through SAP S/4HANA and S/4HANA Public Cloud, enabling consistent policies, master data, controls, and financial reporting across the enterprise.

rows.html: Core general-ledger accounting and period accounting.
General Ledger accounting managed in ERP Federation and other legacy ERPs
SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Workday, Infor
Accounting policies are defined in SharePoint and implemented in SAP configuration
Introduction of additional technologies to support SE-specific accounting policies not supported in S/4HANA standard core, such as BRF+ or SAP PaPM
SAP S/4HANA, BRF+, PaPM accounting rules engine
Trusted finance dimensions: COA, hierarchies and entity governance.

SAP MDG V7 governs financial master data for GL accounts and vendors. Other financial master data is governed directly in legacy ERP. Global hierarchies are governed in Excel and uploaded into applications such as HFM or Tagetik EPM.
All financial master data governed in SAP MDG S/4. Key global hierarchies also governed in MDG S/4, while some referential governance remains in Excel.
SAP MDG, Informatica, Oracle EDM, OneStream
